SUBSTITUTE NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE | Rezoning Attachment 22781T1
2743 North Greenview Avenue
From M2-2 to RT-4

The Property
The subject property is improved with a three-story frame house, wood deck, and detached rear yard garage. The

subject block is zoned RT-4 and RT-3.5 with nearby Residential Planned Developments in a neighborhood
primarily improved with multi-family and detached residential buildings. The property is also a Transit Served
Location per the Transit Oriented Provisions of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, Section 17-10-0102-B (1), as it is
within 701 feet of the Ashland CTA Bus Line Corridor Roadway Segment and 183.76 feet from the Diversey
Parkway CTA Bus Line Corridor Roadway Segment.*

The Project
The Applicant proposes to construct a three-story residential building with three units, three automobile parking

spaces, and three bicycle parking spaces. The zoning height of the building will be 37’ 9”. To allow the proposed
project, the Applicant seeks a zoning change for the subject property from a M2-2 Light Industry District to an
RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District. The Applicant is filing a Type 1 rezoning
application and also seeks all relief as needed as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code for the attached plans,
including: 1) a variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the rear yard setback from 39.05 feet to two feet
to allow a three car garage over 480 square feet; 2) a variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the north
side setback from three feet to zero feet; 3) a variation to reduce the south side setback from two feet to zero feet;
4) a variation under sections 17-13-1003-K and 17-13-1101-A to reduce the required rear-yard open space from
200,15 square feet to zero—224.70 square feet of rear-yard open space will still be provided.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 3,079.25 sq. ft.

Floor Area: 3,69.70 sq. ft.

FAR: 2.0

Residential Dwelling Units: 3

MLA Density: 1,026.42

Height: 37.05 feet

Automobile Parking: 3

Bicycle Parking: 3

Setbacks:
Front (Greenview) 12.5’
Side (North) 0’
Side (South) 0’
Rear 2’

* A set of plans, including a site plan showing the TSL distances to CTA Rail Station is attached.
